transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Um… mostly I’m here because my head just doesn’t feel clear at work. I keep losing track of what clients are saying, and I’ll read the same chart note over and over like it’s not sticking. Then even simple decisions I used to make pretty easily… I kind of freeze.
Have you noticed if these problems with concentration are happening alongside feelings of sadness, low mood, or loss of interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess it’s more that I don’t really want to do anything I used to. My guitar’s just been sitting there, and I keep canceling soccer or the shelter stuff. Even cooking or hiking, if I try, it just feels kind of pointless… like I’m only going through the motions.
Have you been feeling more tired or low on energy lately, even if you're not doing much?
Yeah… pretty much. Even small things feel heavy. Like showering, driving here, finishing paperwork… it feels like I’m dragging around a backpack full of bricks.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days? If so, how long does that usually last each day?
I… I’m not really sure how to measure it. I wouldn’t say I’ve been tracking the hours. It’s just kind of there in the background a lot, I guess.
Can you tell me if most days feel down or depressed to you, even when nothing specific is going on?
I don’t know… I guess a lot of days feel kind of low, even if nothing really happened. It’s just hard to say how much.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, like staying up late unable to fall asleep, or do you find yourself sleeping much more than usual?
Yeah… sleep’s been kind of messed up. I’ll get home exhausted, but then I just lie there for hours thinking over the day. And when I do sleep, I wake up before my alarm feeling like I barely slept.
Have you noticed that you no longer enjoy activities you used to find pleasurable, like playing guitar or hiking?

Yeah… I guess. My guitar’s just been sitting there, and I keep bailing on soccer and the shelter. Even stuff like cooking or hiking, when I try, it just feels like I’m going through the motions. Kind of pointless.
Do you feel down or low most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I mean… a lot of the time I feel low, but I don’t know if it’s most of the day every day.
Can you clarify whether most days you feel down or low for the majority of the day, even when nothing specific is happening?
I… I don’t know. Some days it’s there a lot, yeah, but I’m not sure I can say it’s most of the day. I haven’t really been tracking it like that.
Can you tell me if there are days when you feel down or low for most of the day, even when nothing particularly bad has happened?
Yeah… probably some days. I don’t always know why, either. It’s just kind of there. But I’m not sure how often, exactly.
Can you tell me if, on most days, you feel down or low for most of the day, even when nothing specific is happening?
I’m still not totally sure. It happens a lot, but saying “most of the day on most days” feels… hard to pin down. I don’t really keep track that way.
Can you tell me if there have been times when you’ve felt down or low for most of the day, even when nothing in particular was bothering you?
I mean… yeah, there have been times like that. I can’t really say how often or how long exactly, but it’s happened.
Can you tell me if you’ve been feeling this way — with low mood, trouble concentrating, and loss of interest — for at least two weeks straight?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been about a month, I guess. Since the clinic lost some staff and my schedule got pushed into late evenings, with more crisis paperwork. It’s kind of been there since then.

Can you tell me if there were specific days in the past month when your low mood, trouble concentrating, and loss of interest were bad enough that you had real trouble getting through your day — like work, socializing, or even basic tasks?

Yeah… there were. I don’t really want to get into every day, but it got bad enough at work that I told my supervisor I needed help. I was making mistakes and hesitating, and it felt like it could affect client care. I didn’t really trust myself to keep working safely without being checked out.
Can you tell me if there have been days in the past month when your low mood, trouble concentrating, and loss of interest were present for most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days, I think. It’s been going on about a month, since the clinic lost staff and my schedule got shifted later, with more crisis paperwork. It’s kind of just been there through the day.
Can you tell me if, over the past month, there have been days when you felt depressed or down for most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not totally sure how to measure “nearly every day.” I mean… there have been a lot of days where I felt down for most of it, yeah. I just haven’t really been tracking it.

Can you confirm if, over the past month, there has been a continuous stretch of at least two weeks where you felt down or low most of the day, nearly every day, without a significant improvement or break in symptoms?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been about a month now, since the clinic lost staff and my schedule got pushed later with more crisis paperwork. I don’t remember much of a real break in it.
Can you confirm that, at times, your low mood has lasted for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks without a real break?
Yeah… I can confirm that. It’s been going on about a month, since the clinic lost staff and my schedule shifted later with more crisis paperwork. There hasn’t really been a real break.
